4. The root cause can be one value or many values of that column. Include every value that materially drives the change, and nothing else.
5. Answer.

{"resource": [{"name": "<resource name>", "type": "<resource type>"}]}

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw'].copy()
anom_date = '2025-10-20'
base_dates = [d for d in acc.date.unique() if '2025-10-06' <= d < anom_date]
base = acc[acc.date.isin(base_dates)]
anom = acc[acc.date==anom_date]
print('baseline days:', len(base_dates))
print('total base avg/day:', base.unblended_cost.sum()/len(base_dates))
print('total anom day:', anom.unblended_cost.sum())

cat_cols = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
for c in cat_cols:
    b = base.groupby(c).unblended_cost.sum()/len(base_dates)
    a = anom.groupby(c).unblended_cost.sum()
    comp = pd.DataFrame({'base':b,'anom':a}).fillna(0)
    comp['delta'] = comp.anom - comp.base
    print('\n===', c, '===')
    print(comp[comp.delta.abs()>0.5].sort_values('delta', key=abs, ascending=False).head(15))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw'].copy()
anom_date='2025-10-20'
base_dates=[d for d in acc.date.unique() if '2025-10-06'<=d<anom_date]
base=acc[acc.date.isin(base_dates)]
anom=acc[acc.date==anom_date]

# Sum of positive deltas per dimension
cols=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
for c in cols:
    b=base.groupby(c).unblended_cost.sum()/len(base_dates)
    a=anom.groupby(c).unblended_cost.sum()
    d=(a-b).fillna(0)
    print(c, 'sum positive deltas: %.2f' % d[d>0].sum(), '| top values:', d.sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).round(1).to_dict())

# Verify 1:1 mapping of the top-3 families to apps/services
for fam in ['GWymgjl2rF','wXs6GRnJz0','CXGOJ39RZm']:
    sub=acc[acc.instance_family==fam]
    print(fam, sub[['csp','cloud_service','application']].drop_duplicates().values.tolist())

# Are these families stable over the whole period? (i.e., not new resources)
for fam in ['GWymgjl2rF','wXs6GRnJz0','CXGOJ39RZm']:
    sub=acc[acc.instance_family==fam]
    daily=sub.groupby('date').unblended_cost.sum()
    print(fam, 'days seen:', len(daily), 'max day cost:', daily.max().round(2), 'on', daily.idxmax())
